root_cause: Sense pours (SENSEC1_LO, SENSEC2_LO) have high foreign cross counts (18 and 11 respectively), causing conductor over-temp FEM flags and likely contributing to DRC errors. Additionally, there are 2 unconnected nets and 12 DRC violations. The router is crossing the sense pours with other signals, leading to thermal issues and clearance violations.
reasoning: The board has gates_pass=false due to structural DRC=12 and unconnected nets=2. FEM flags indicate over-temp on sense nets, correlated with high foreign_cross counts in pour-integrity. The corridor-avoid lever does not fire because clipped_nets is empty, but the foreign crossings can be addressed by routing offending signals around the sense corridors. Placement appears acceptable (kelvin_ok=true, diffpair_ok=true), so routing adjustments are the appropriate lever.

proposed_lever.detail: Route foreign signals crossing SENSEC1_LO and SENSEC2_LO around the sense corridors using waypoint intents. Increase router effort to resolve remaining DRC errors and unconnected nets.
